# Independent JPEG Group library

Version 10, released 2026-01-25. Official source:
https://www.ijg.org/files/jpegsrc.v10.tar.gz

SHA-256: `8b9eaa13242690ebd03e1728ab1edf97a81a78ed6e83624d493655f31ac95ab5`

The source archive is unmodified. README.ijg is the original upstream README,
including its legal conditions. This software is based in part on the work of
the Independent JPEG Group. The DjVuLibre build script compiles it statically
for arm64/macOS14, using Apple Command Line Tools, without Homebrew or CMake.
It is not linked into the Swift application or extensions themselves.
